page.layout: One column of verse, centred under a two-line heading (author's name above "Carmen."). No running head, page number, catchword or signature. Faint show-through from the reverse side at the top and left margin is not transcribed.

main_text.head: FRANCISCI BERALDI Carmen.
main_text.p: EN quibus illi celebris liber hic blanditur mentis: En quales titulos pagina prima geri:.
Exilium, tormenta, cruces & verbera, flammas, Præcisus linguas, sulphura, vincla, famem.
Quaeque tyrannorum rabies immanis & exlex Infanda in solos cogitat usque pios.
Qualia si videat Stygÿs revocatus ab umbris, Ingemat, & pallens horreat ipse Nero.
Detque manus victas: & se contenderit istis Cedere, qui reliquos vicerit, Antiochus.
Talis[?] fonte[?] liber, quemnam Speciosus inescet, Indice vel solo qui nocuisse potest?
Ergo Stultitiae damnabitur, hunc tibi, Lector, Qui magnis librum sumptibus exhibuit?
Immo satis prudens perse prouidit, ut ambo, Et pius atque pijs hostis, habere velint.
Hoc pius in speculo, paria ad certamina quando, Si quando veniet, quos imitetur habet.
Unde petenda fiet, longis constantia vinclis, Blanditias spernens, Iudicis atque minas: Unde etiam medijs mens imperterrita flammis, Imploransque Deum libera lingua suum.
Denique tela, quibus mundus superatur, & Orci Triste triumphati corruit imperium: Præsertim memori Christum quum mente revoluet Ista tulisse Ducem signa sequenda suis.
Impius hic contra, sævi monumenta furoris Spectabit lætus non moritura sui.
Quippe patris Stygÿ vestigia nota prementem, Sese æquasse decus, vel superasse sciet.
Ergo pium ut celebrem crudelia funera reddunt, Sic illi felicitas[?] nomina clara dabit.

page.notes: Doubtful readings: line 1 "illi" (the letters after "ill" are unclear, with a mark that may be a colon). "Talis[?] fonte[?]" in the fifth stanza is uncertain: the first word is set oddly and the second may not be "fonte". "Detque" in the fourth stanza is uncertain. "Imploransque" and "felicitas" are read from a damaged line. Printed "Stygÿs" and "Stygÿ" keep the printer's mark over the y. Long s is transcribed as plain s throughout. Faint show-through of a running head at the top of the page is not transcribed.
